title: One Light-Day Out

mood.label: Uneasy calm
mood.summary: Uneasy calm (45): Israeli tanks crossed Gaza's Yellow Line, ships burned in Hormuz and markets slid a fifth day while Trump, Xi and Putin met in Shenzhen. Against it: blue whales rebounding tenfold and Voyager 1 one light-day from home.

style.genre: cold-wave — bowed vibraphone, glockenspiel, timpani, Oberheim DMX

lines: three men at a Shenzhen table,
the market slips a fifth straight day,
the debt climbs toward a hundred percent,
The Hague weighs what it will say.
One light-day out, the old probe hums,
the blue whales came back ten for one,
the Tunis olive groves hang heavy —
calm on top, and the deep still runs.
